id: 407
status: Fixed
summary: Order of jscomp_error, jscomp_warning, jscomp_off flags are not preserved
labels: ['Type-Defect', 'Priority-Medium']
stars: 1
commentCount: 2
Comment 0 (2011-04-04): "off" always takes precedence over "warning", and "warning" always takes precedence over "error" This should be changed so that the last arguments always has highest precedence.
Comment 1 (2011-04-07): This issue was closed by revision r973.
